b1-populismo-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is Populism?
b1-populismo-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos watched a documentary about Latin American populism, and he asks how the film defined the word.
b1-populismo-01.prompt: Tell Carlos how populism is usually defined.
cues: Say that the word is usually used for certain movements
Say that their leaders spoke in the name of the people
b1-populismo-01.target: Se suele llamar populismo a los movimientos que hablaban en nombre del pueblo.
b1-populismo-01.english: The movements that spoke in the name of the people are usually called populism.
b1-populismo-01.canDo: I can say how Latin American populism is usually defined.

b1-populismo-02.title: Communicative Challenge: 17 October 1945
b1-populismo-02.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos visited a museum exhibition about Perón, and he asks what happened on 17 October 1945.
b1-populismo-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what happened that day.
cues: Say that many workers marched to the square
Say what Perón did while the crowd was waiting
b1-populismo-02.target: El 17 de octubre de 1945 muchos trabajadores marcharon a la plaza. Mientras la multitud esperaba, Perón habló desde un balcón.
b1-populismo-02.english: On 17 October 1945 many workers marched to the square. While the crowd was waiting, Perón spoke from a balcony.
b1-populismo-02.canDo: I can tell how Perón gained the support of the workers.

b1-populismo-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Presidents
b1-populismo-03.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg were in a class about Latin American history, and she asks what you remember about Lázaro Cárdenas.
b1-populismo-03.prompt: Tell Meg what kind of president Cárdenas was.
cues: Say that Cárdenas was a president
Say what his government did for the peasants
b1-populismo-03.target: Cárdenas fue un presidente cuyo gobierno repartió tierras a los campesinos.
b1-populismo-03.english: Cárdenas was a president whose government gave land to the peasants.
b1-populismo-03.canDo: I can say what Cárdenas did for the peasants and the workers.

b1-populismo-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Do Historians Agree?
b1-populismo-04.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos watched a documentary about populist leaders, and he asks what the historians in the film said about the link between a leader and the people.
b1-populismo-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what some historians believe and what others do not believe.
cues: Say what some historians believe about the direct link
Say what others do not believe about it
b1-populismo-04.target: Algunos historiadores creen que el vínculo directo dio voz al pueblo, pero otros no creen que sea bueno para la democracia.
b1-populismo-04.english: Some historians believe that the direct link gave a voice to the people, but others do not believe that it is good for democracy.
b1-populismo-04.canDo: I can describe how populist leaders spoke to the people.

b1-populismo-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Praise and Criticism
b1-populismo-05.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg have just finished a class on Latin American populism, and she asks you for a short summary of the results of these governments.
b1-populismo-05.prompt: Tell Meg one good result and one criticism.
cues: Say what the governments did for the workers
Say what the critics said, with a connector
b1-populismo-05.target: Los gobiernos ampliaron los derechos de los trabajadores. Sin embargo, concentraron mucho poder.
b1-populismo-05.english: The governments extended the rights of the workers. However, they concentrated a lot of power.
b1-populismo-05.canDo: I can say what these governments left to the workers.

b1-populismo-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Populism: A Summary
b1-populismo-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have just finished a unit on Latin American populism, and he asks you for a short summary.
b1-populismo-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what the word populism is used for and what historians say about it.
cues: Say how these movements are usually called
Say what some historians do not believe, with a connector
b1-populismo-consolidation.target: Se suele llamar populismo a los movimientos de Perón, Vargas y Cárdenas. Sin embargo, algunos historiadores no creen que el populismo sea una ideología.
b1-populismo-consolidation.english: These movements of Perón, Vargas and Cárdenas are usually called populism. However, some historians do not believe that populism is an ideology.
b1-populismo-consolidation.canDo: I can say how populism is usually defined and why the word is disputed.
